# research: composer alias support

Find a one-step way to upgrade a single Composer dependency. Composer needs two commands where npm needs one:

```bash
$ composer require some:version
$ composer update some
```

The wish is a `composer up some:version` shortcut, but Composer has no built-in alias mechanism; the candidate is the [slince/composer-alias](https://github.com/slince/composer-alias) plugin, and the note asks to investigate the `require`/`update` chain first (cf. the [Stack Overflow thread](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/16739998/how-to-update-a-single-library-with-composer)).
